questions.q: What is the smallest prime number?
questions.explanation: 2 is the smallest prime number. It is also the only even prime number.

questions.q: The LCM of two numbers is 12 and their HCF is 2. If one number is 6, what is the other number?
questions.explanation: Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM = 2 × 12 = 24. If one number is 6, the other is 24 ÷ 6 = 4.
